allow: PowerShell($proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3002 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if \($proc\) { Stop-Process -Id $proc -Force; "Port 3002 kapatıldı \(PID $proc\)" } else { "Port 3002 zaten boş" })

PowerShell($pid = 36776; $proc = Get-Process -Id $pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($proc\) { "Proses: $\($proc.ProcessName\) \(PID $pid\)"; Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force; "Kapatıldı." } else { "PID bulunamadı" })
PowerShell($p = Get-Process -Id 36776 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "Proses: $\($p.ProcessName\)"; Stop-Process -Id 36776 -Force; "Kapatıldı." } else { "Bulunamadı" })

PowerShell($p = Get-Process -Name "node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -eq "" } | Select-Object -First 1; if \($p\) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; "Node kapatıldı" } else { "Çalışan node yok" })
